summary: Bring-your-own Hubble V2 endpoint with optional API key override for cross-market historical/context fetches and Auto-Quant CSV intake without changing the zero-config yfinance default.

data_contracts.label: Hubble V2 base URL via environment with optional API key override
notes: Set the endpoint outside the repo before running Hubble-backed fetches.
ICT_ENGINE_HUBBLE_API_KEY is optional and overrides the upstream-compatible default key fallback when provided.
Do not commit hostnames or real keys into provider profiles, docs, or command history.

data_contracts.label: Hubble market-specific symbol formatting
notes: CN symbols require exchange suffixes, HK uses .HK and explicit date ranges, US uses ticker symbols, and crypto also requires --exchange.

provider_tracks.label: Opt-in Hubble market-data path
notes: Choose this only when the operator explicitly wants Hubble V2 instead of the zero-config yfinance lane or a local IBKR runtime.
Current repo slice wires provider-status plus fetch_external.py hubble-kline. Live-runtime adoption remains a separate opt-in implementation step.
